description_en: Queries the details of task flows by page
description_zh: 调用ListTaskFlowsByPage接口，分页获取任务流详情列表
name: ListTaskFlowsByPage

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the tenant.

: To view the ID of the tenant, go to the Data Management (DMS) console and move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en: Filter condition, task flow ID list
parameters.name: dag_id_list

parameters.help_en: The keyword that is used to search for task flow names
parameters.help_zh: 搜索任务流名称关键字
parameters.name: search_key

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return
parameters.name: page_index

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page
parameters.name: page_size

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned if the request failed

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the request failed
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误信息

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：
true：请求成功。
false：请求失败

TaskFlow.description_en: The details of the returned task flows

CreatorId.description_en: The ID of the user who created the task flow

CreatorNickName.description_en: The username of the user who created the task flow
CreatorNickName.description_zh: 创建任务流用户的昵称

CronBeginDate.description_en: The start time of scheduled scheduling. The task flow is not scheduled before this point in time
CronBeginDate.description_zh: 定时调度开始时间，此时间点之前任务流不进行调度

CronEndDate.description_en: The end time of scheduled scheduling. The task flow is not scheduled after this point in time
CronEndDate.description_zh: 定时调度结束时间，此时间点之后任务流不进行调度

CronType.description_en:
Scheduling cycle type. Valid values:
2: Hourly scheduling
3: Daily scheduling
4: Weekly scheduling
5: Monthly scheduling
CronType.description_zh:
调度周期类型。取值如下：
2: 小时级调度
3: 日级调度
4: 周级调度
5: 月级调度

DagName.description_en: The name of the task flow

DagOwnerId.description_en: The user ID of the task flow owner

DagOwnerNickName.description_en: The username of the owner of the task flow

DeployId.description_en: The ID of the last deployment record of the task flow

Description.description_en: The description of the task flow

Id.description_en: The ID of the task flow

LatestInstanceStatus.description_en:
The status of the last execution of the task flow. Valid values:

0: invalid
1: scheduling disabled
2: waiting to be scheduled
LatestInstanceStatus.description_zh:
最后一个运行记录的状态，返回值如下：
0：无效。
1：无调度配置。
2：等待调度

LatestInstanceTime.description_en: The time when the last execution record was created
LatestInstanceTime.description_zh: 最近一个运行记录的创建时间

ScenarioId.description_en: The ID of the application scenario

ScheduleParam.description_en: Event scheduling configuration, JSON string format
ScheduleParam.description_zh: 事件调度配置，JSON字符串格式

Status.description_en:
The status of the task flow. Valid values:

0: invalid
1: scheduling disabled
2: waiting to be scheduled
Status.description_zh:
任务流状态，返回值如下：
0：无效。
1：无调度配置。
2：等待调度

TimeZoneId.description_en: Time zone setting. Default value: East 8(Asia/Shanghai)
TimeZoneId.description_zh: 时区设置，默认为东八区（Asia/Shanghai）

TriggerType.description_en:
The trigger type. Valid values:
0: Periodic scheduling
1: Run manually
TriggerType.description_zh:
触发类型。返回值如下：
0：周期调度
1：手动运行

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
